topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration introduces variable interference, affecting A2G and satellite link coordination. Adaptive modulation and beamforming mitigate interference, but require careful power control to maintain link quality. Doppler shift and multi-path fading exacerbate signal degradation, straining capacity and performance.
reference_context: L-DACS operates in L-band, mitigating VHF saturation, providing secure data services with FDD and TDD techniques.
